title: Marlow Valley harvest 2026
brief: The Marlow Valley Extension Service wants a harvest 2026 summary for farmers and the county boards, from a survey of 214 farms completed on 2026-10-10. Season rainfall in millimetres and yields in tonnes per hectare by county. Alder: rainfall 612, wheat 7.4, corn 10.2, soybeans 3.4, barley 6.1. Brennan: 548, 6.8, 9.1, 3.1, 5.7. Calder: 701, 8.1, 11.4, 3.7, 6.6. Dunmore: 489, 5.9, 8.3, 2.8, 4.9. Elmstead: 655, 7.7, 10.8, 3.5, 6.3. Region averages across the five counties: rainfall 601, wheat 7.2, corn 10.0, soybeans 3.3, barley 5.9. Calder, the wettest county, had the best yield in every crop; Dunmore, the driest, had the lowest in every crop, and its wheat yield of 5.9 is 2.2 below Calder's. Sections: "Harvest at a glance", "Yields by county" and "Rainfall and yield". The wide table will be read on phones, so make sure it is usable on a narrow screen.

edit.request: Brennan's corn yield was corrected to 9.6, which makes the region corn average 10.1.
